Subject: OrionLink — Activation guardrails & nominated owner (post-sign)

Sanjay / Procurement team — thanks again for signing. Quick handoff from sales into CS so we can lock the kickoff date and outstanding items. Summary below and next steps at the end.

Deal context (short):
- MRC start: 2027-07-01; 3 reserved GPU nodes (dedicated) for inference, expected 150k tokens/day.
- Data residency: US-only; customer will route traffic through their VPC (private deployment option).
- SOW attached (final pdf).

Open / outstanding items before kickoff:
1) Final onboarding window: customer prefers week of 2027-07-11 for tech kickoff (engineering availability noted below).
2) SOC evidence request: they asked for SOC2 summary and logging retention policy — attached.
3) Ingestion plan: sample dataset + 1 test endpoint; need onboarding API key + test corpus (customer to provide).
4) E2E success criteria: 99th percentile latency <120ms for 512-token inference (we recommended quantized model variant).

Internal notes for CS (Karthik, Monica):
- Primary contact at OrionLink is Sanjay Mehta (CTO). Secondary: procurement@orionlink.ai for contract/purchase order.
- Billings: PO arrives by 2027-06-28; finance contact cc'ed in deal record.
- Technical: they run in us-west-2 and will require a dedicated VPC peering + CIDR allowlist.
- Suggested kickoff agenda attached (OrionLink_Kickoff_Agenda.docx).

Requested next steps (simple):
- Karthik: nominate primary CS owner and confirm availability for 07/11–07/15 kickoff (30–60 min tech pre-check + 90 min kickoff).
- Monica: confirm SOC2 artifacts are sufficient, and if not, request specifics from Sanjay.
- Sanjay/Procurement: confirm preferred kickoff date/time and send test corpus by 07/06.

Attachments: [Attachment: OrionLink_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)], [Attachment: OrionLink_Kickoff_Agenda.docx (DOCX, 28KB)], [Attachment: SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]

Thanks Rachel — good summary. I can take primary ownership for this engagement. Quick notes and proposed plan: 

1) Owner / staffing
- Primary CS lead (me): Karthik Iyer (technical onboarding, infra handoff).
- Secondary/Success manager: Monica Patel (works on adoption and acceptance criteria).
- Escalation: Rachel (sales) and platform reliability on standby.

2) Proposed kickoff timeline
- Engineering pre-check (30 min): 2027-07-11 10:00 AM PT — to validate VPC peering and sample corpus format.
- Technical kickoff (90 min): 2027-07-12 09:30 AM PT — agenda covers model selection, quantization profile, latency targets, and acceptance tests.
- Acceptance window: 2 weeks post-kickoff for performance tuning and monitoring setup.

3) Pre-kickoff asks for customer (to get ready by 07/06):
- Provide 1 representative test corpus (JSONL) and expected throughput profile.
- Confirm VPC peering CIDR block and point-of-contact for network team.
- Confirm which model variant they want pinned for canary. If undecided, we recommend the quantized-4bit-gptv2-medium variant.

4) Compliance artifacts
- Monica: I reviewed the SOC2 summary attached. One missing item: audit log retention policy export example (we have a template, see link). If Monica flags gaps, we'll request the specific export.

I'll start a kickoff calendar invite once Rachel confirms customer availability. If anyone prefers a different owner, speak now — otherwise I'll record this in the deal.

-Karthik
